Due to the Trump administration’s latest sanctions action, students of Iranian nationality or heritage, including U.S. citizens and residents, had their Law School Admission Council (LSAC) accounts suspended at a crucial point in the law school admissions cycle.

Students who want to become lawyers and contribute to upholding justice in this country should not be blocked from pursuing their education simply because of their national origin or heritage. @CongressMin and I are demanding that @LSAC_Official immediately review and restore improperly restricted accounts and explain why U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, and others residing in the United States were affected.
